description: This file defines the class AM_ProjectTemplatesListViewData, which extends ListViewData, and provides methods related to listing view data for project templates in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM application. It includes a method to generate HTML for AJAX-loaded details in a list view.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesListViewData
classes.description: A class responsible for providing list view data for project templates, including generating additional AJAX-loaded details.

methods.name: getAdditionalDetailsAjax
methods.description: Generates HTML snippets for additional record details to be retrieved asynchronously via AJAX in the list view.
